parameters.jsCode:
const topic = $('🔍 Find PENDING Row').item(0).json.topic;
const rowNumber = $('🔍 Find PENDING Row').item(0).json.rowNumber;

const scriptPrompt = 'Write a kids educational YouTube song for the SnifflePaws channel.

Topic: ' + topic + '
Character: SnifflePaws the friendly orange fox
Audience: toddlers and babies ages 1-5

Write 20-25 simple fun rhyming lyric lines. Max 8 words each.
Each line teaches one clear concept about the topic.
Bright, happy, energetic. Include repetition. Kids should be able to sing along.
First line: "Hello friends! SnifflePaws is here!"
Last line: "Great job friends! See you next time!"

Return ONLY the lyrics. One line per line. No brackets. No stage directions. No headers.';

const titlePrompt = 'Create the perfect YouTube video title for a kids educational song.

Topic: ' + topic + '
Channel: SnifflePaws

Rules:
- Include the main concept (e.g. ABC Song, Colors Song, Numbers Song)
- Include for Kids or for Babies or Toddler Learning
- End with | SnifflePaws
- Under 70 characters total
- Max search appeal

Return ONLY the title. One line. No quotes. No explanation.';

const descPrompt = 'Write a YouTube video description for a SnifflePaws kids educational song.
Topic: ' + topic + '

Include:
1. Two warm sentences welcoming toddlers and parents
2. What kids will learn in this video (3 short bullet points with emoji)
3. Encourage subscribing and turning on notifications
4. End with these hashtags: #KidsLearning #SnifflePaws #ToddlerVideos #NurseryRhymes #EducationalKids

Under 300 words. Keep it warm and friendly.';

const tagsPrompt = 'Generate exactly 15 YouTube search tags for a kids educational video.
Topic: ' + topic + '

Return ONLY a valid JSON array of strings. Nothing else.
Example: ["abc song for kids","learn alphabet"]

Must include: topic keywords, "for kids", "for toddlers", "nursery rhyme", "kids song", "SnifflePaws", "educational", "babies", "toddler learning".';

const thumbnailPrompt = 'Children YouTube thumbnail illustration. Cute cartoon orange fox character named SnifflePaws with big friendly eyes and a wide smile, holding a sign that says "' + topic + '". Bright colorful background with stars and sparkles. Bold bubbly text at the top. Style: clean 2D children cartoon, bright primary colors red yellow blue green, no copyright, safe for kids, white outline around character. High energy, fun, engaging for toddlers.';

const scriptBody = {model:'claude-sonnet-4-20250514', max_tokens:1024, messages:[{role:'user', content:scriptPrompt}]};
const titleBody = {model:'claude-sonnet-4-20250514', max_tokens:200, messages:[{role:'user', content:titlePrompt}]};
const descBody = {model:'claude-sonnet-4-20250514', max_tokens:700, messages:[{role:'user', content:descPrompt}]};
const tagsBody = {model:'claude-sonnet-4-20250514', max_tokens:300, messages:[{role:'user', content:tagsPrompt}]};

return [{json:{topic, rowNumber, scriptBody, titleBody, descBody, tagsBody, thumbnailPrompt}}];

nodes.name: 🎤 Generate Voiceover

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { text: $json.ttsText, model_id: 'eleven_monolingual_v1', voice_settings: { stability: 0.75, similarity_boost: 0.85, style: 0.6, use_speaker_boost: true } } }}

nodes.notes: Voice ID EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaL is Bella — warm and friendly. Replace with any ElevenLabs voice ID. Returns binary MP3 audio.

nodes.name: ☁️ Upload Audio to Drive

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({name: $('⚙️ Parse & Format Copy').item(0).json.topic + '_audio.mp3', mimeType: 'audio/mpeg', parents: [$env.DRIVE_FOLDER_ID]}) }}

nodes.notes: Uploads the ElevenLabs audio to Google Drive. Set GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN and DRIVE_FOLDER_ID env vars. The folder must exist and be shared publicly.

nodes.name: ✅ Render Complete?
nodes.notes: If status is 'done', continue. If 'failed', stop. Otherwise loops back to Wait.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: 'dall-e-3', prompt: $('⚙️ Parse & Format Copy').item(0).json.thumbnailPrompt, size: '1280x720', quality: 'hd', n: 1 } }}

nodes.name: 🚀 Init YouTube Upload

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { snippet: { title: $('⚙️ Parse & Format Copy').item(0).json.title, description: $('⚙️ Parse & Format Copy').item(0).json.description, tags: $('⚙️ Parse & Format Copy').item(0).json.tags, categoryId: '27', defaultLanguage: 'en' }, status: { privacyStatus: 'private', selfDeclaredMadeForKids: true } } }}

nodes.notes: categoryId 27 = Education. selfDeclaredMadeForKids=true required for kids content. Returns Location header with resumable upload URL.

nodes.name: 📤 Upload Video to YouTube
nodes.notes: Sends the binary video to the YouTube resumable upload URL. Returns the video ID in the response.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { snippet: { playlistId: $env.YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_ID, resourceId: { kind: 'youtube#video', videoId: $('📤 Upload Video to YouTube').item(0).json.id } } } }}
={{ { id: $json.videoId, status: { privacyStatus: 'private', publishAt: $json.publishAt, selfDeclaredMadeForKids: true } } }}
parameters.notes: Sets the video to go live at the calculated peak time. Uses 'private' + publishAt for scheduled publishing.
